fields.title: 📖 Dying with knowledge of Tawḥīd
fields.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“Whoever dies while he **knows** that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah enters Paradise.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Tawḥīd is not merely a word — it requires **knowledge, meaning, and affirmation**.

immutable.source: 📝 Muslim, Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim, Kitāb al-Īmān, Hadith Nr. 26; überliefert von ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān.
